# Move to Annual Billing

**Decision (2026-06-30):** offer annual billing at a 16% discount on every plan in
the [[Pricing Ladder]]. Invoices go through [[Quill Payments]].

## Why
- [[Harbor Analytics]] asked for one invoice per year.
- Annual plans cut involuntary churn from failed cards.
